Extract all links from a document into metadata

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<html><head><title>Links Page</title></head><body><p>Visit <a href=\"https://example.com\">Example</a> or <a href=\"https://docs.example.com\">Docs</a>.</p><p>Also see <a href=\"/relative/path\">relative link</a> and <a href=\"mailto:hello@example.com\">email us</a>.</p></body></html>", options = ConversionOptions$from_json(jsonlite::toJSON(list("extract_metadata" = TRUE), auto_unbox = TRUE)))
print(result)
```
